canada.summary: Quebec provincial police have located a 79-year-old man who had been missing since Oct. 25.

canada.title: Former officer accused in 3 sexual assault cases no longer employed by RCMP
canada.summary: The third case of sexual assault involving a former RCMP constable was dismissed on Monday after the Crown brought no evidence. The RCMP said Tuesday William McNutt, 41, is now no longer an employee.

canada.title: Saint John public-safety project to focus on foot patrols after mixed reviews
canada.summary: A public safety project that's brought private security guards to parts of Saint John is aiming to improve its foot patrols and overnight services, city councillors heard Monday.

canada.title: Doerkson's promise to roll back density policies could ease stress for municipalities, B.C. mayors say
canada.summary: Premier-designate Lorne Doerkson's promise to roll back provincial housing targets has some municipal leaders feeling hopeful, after previous goals proved challenging for some.

canada.title: Jasper to gain land-use authority after 30-year push
canada.summary: Parks Canada and the municipality of Jasper are working together to transfer land-use authority from the federal agency to local governance. Richard Ireland has spent 30 years fighting for local planning control, a battle sparked decades ago over perceptions that Banff mishandled its own development powers.

canada.title: Toronto’s child hunger rates nearly double as city sees 4.1M food bank visits: report
canada.summary: The Toronto resident is often looking for milk, eggs and vegetables such as potatoes or carrots, to make sure his children get the nutrition they need.

canada.title: OSAP pause hits paramedic students bound to work in underserved areas
canada.summary: Some paramedic students approved to receive funding through a government program aiming to boost health-care staffing have been swept up in the provincewide pause on student aid.

canada.title: AI data centre proponent in Nova Scotia makes its pitch to Cape Breton communities
canada.summary: The proponent of a major artificial intelligence data centre proposal in southern Cape Breton is slated to make its pitch to local residents in person.

canada.title: New city councillors face decisions on whether to speak directly to public, or go through city hall
canada.summary: Whether it's responding to a neighbour about a pothole or answering questions from a reporter about a controversial bylaw, newly elected city councillors will have to navigate how they want to interact with the public over the next four years.

canada.title: 'Serious' opioid addiction cited after man accused of murder found with fentanyl in jail
canada.summary: A man whose murder trial starts next week is currently serving a sentence for trafficking a drug new to Saskatchewan — and was caught with two chunks of fentanyl while in prison.

canada.title: Record number of 9 departing Winnipeg councillors eligible for a combined total of about $525K in severance
canada.summary: As nine new city councillors are set to take the oath of office Tuesday, the City of Winnipeg is set to pay out severance to a record number of departing council members after last week's civic election.

canada.title: First Nation in Manitoba's Interlake reclaiming its Cree language identity through lessons
canada.summary: Students from nursery to Grade 6 in Fisher River are taking Cree classes every other day of the week, in a push to improve fluency. Most adults in the community, located in Manitoba's Interlake, can't speak the language.

canada.title: N.L. nurses turn to court to halt nurses’ union revote, confirm earlier election results
canada.summary: Three nurses, including one voted in as president of the province's Registered Nurses' Union, want the courts to stop a planned revote for later this month and confirm the earlier election results.
